evidence_quotes.O: All sound just great and dandy through the NuForce and you can really tell the sonic differences between them.
evidence_quotes.C: Application is critical. Take your time, make sure the screen is clean and dust free (compressed air is your friend).
evidence_quotes.E: DO NOT buy no name batteries on ebay. They do not last worth a darn and are basically a waste of money! Don't do it...
evidence_quotes.A: I am puzzled and confused by the Amazon reviews, which I have come to trust on most products.
evidence_quotes.N: it is possible to strip the threads--I did it and glad I ordered a few of these for future projects.
